recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless OO makes a new terminology decision to reintroduce LOINC method part codes with explicit filter semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-5600 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction for FHIR-core Observation asking whether ValueSet/observation-methods used an incorrect LOINC filter with property Type and value Method when the intended method part codes were identified by LP-style codes.
initial_application: Commit 0360bc4248328919580b1ae4031956301106de1d initially applied FHIR-5600 by changing the old LOINC include comment from LP to ^LP and changing the filter value from Method to METHOD_TYP.
additional_context: FHIR-8399 later revisited the same Observation Methods LOINC include, found Type = METHOD_TYP invalid, and commit f16ff276ebde2a99c3ef4bd03b9e020f89144335 removed the LOINC include. The current source defines observation-methods from SNOMED CT filters only, and Observation.method still binds to that active value set.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current build-scope source already avoids the incorrect LOINC filtering.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue in the same artifact removed the invalid LOINC include.
